# 999 — QA feedback log

Manual-verification findings for this project, recorded by the **qa-feedback**
skill while walking the `qa-manual-verification/NNN-*.md` scenarios and consumed
by **qa-address-issues** when fixing them. This is the reserved `999` slot — a
log, not a product scenario; never assign `999` to a user-facing flow.

## Legend

**Severity:** `blocker` (blocks the flow) · `high` (breaks an important feature,
workaround exists) · `medium` (works badly, does not block) · `low` (minor
annoyance) · `cosmetic` (text/style).

**Status:** `open` → `in review` → `confirmed` → `resolved`, or
`open`/`confirmed` → `dismissed`. New findings always start at `open`; only the
**qa-address-issues** workflow advances them.
